files.main.xu:
@main
#ui
#ui/draw
#ui/layout
#ui/widgets
#playground

fn box(x f64,y f64,w f64,h f64) layout.Rect {
    << layout.Rect{x: x,y: y,width: w,height: h}
}
fn labels(context &draw.Context,values []string) []draw.TextLayout {
    options := draw.text_options(15.0)
    $result := []draw.TextLayout{}
    for value in values { shaped := context.layout_text(&value,&options) or >>
        result.push(shaped) }
    << result
}
fn demo() int {
    identity := playground.canvas_identity()
    context := draw.default_context()
    theme := playground.dark_theme()
    styles := playground.dark_styles()
    tab_labels := labels(&context,["Basics", "Data / Scroll", "Display"] ) or >>
    $button_label := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Button +1")
    $check_label := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Checkbox")
    $switch_label := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Switch")
    $radio_a_label := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Radio A")
    $radio_b_label := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Radio B")
    rows := labels(&context,["Array", "Map", "Struct", "Channel", "Ownership", "AOT", "WASM", "Native"]) or >>
    $tabs := widgets.tabs(&identity,1,&box(20.0,44.0,600.0,38.0),3,0) or >>
    $button := widgets.button(&identity,2,&box(32.0,106.0,158.0,40.0)) or >>
    $check := widgets.checkbox(&identity,3,&box(32.0,160.0,240.0,44.0),false) or >>
    $toggle := widgets.switch_control(&identity,4,&box(32.0,210.0,240.0,44.0),false) or >>
    $slider := widgets.slider(&identity,5,&box(322.0,112.0,272.0,32.0),0.0,100.0,40.0) or >>
    slider.set_step(5.0) or >>
    $radio_a := widgets.radio(&identity,6,&box(322.0,170.0,260.0,44.0),0,true) or >>
    $radio_b := widgets.radio(&identity,7,&box(322.0,220.0,260.0,44.0),1,false) or >>
    $list := widgets.list_box(&identity,8,&box(32.0,114.0,254.0,172.0),8,0) or >>
    $scroll := widgets.scroll(&identity,9,&box(322.0,114.0,276.0,172.0),widgets.AXIS_VERTICAL,336.0) or >>
    card := widgets.card(&box(28.0,102.0,584.0,200.0)) or >>
    $badge := widgets.badge(&box(478.0,116.0,110.0,30.0)) or >>
    badge.set_selected(true)
    badge_labels := labels(&context,["Shared Xu"]) or >>
    badge_label := badge_labels[0]
    $title := widgets.styled_label(&context,&"Desktop control logic")
    $editor := widgets.input(&context,&identity,10,&box(52.0,244.0,536.0,38.0),&"Read-only Editor / Xu ownership") or >>
    editor.set_read_only(true) or >>
    $progress := widgets.progress(&box(52.0,208.0,164.0,18.0),0.4) or >>
    $invalid_progress := widgets.progress(&box(238.0,208.0,164.0,18.0),0.4) or >>
    invalid_progress.set_invalid(true)
    $disabled_progress := widgets.progress(&box(424.0,208.0,164.0,18.0),0.4) or >>
    disabled_progress.set_enabled(false)
    $focus := widgets.focus_group(&identity,[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]) or >>
    $applied_focus := 0
    $count := 0
    $selected := 0
    while true {
        input := playground.next_input()
        if input.kind == 0 { <- }
        old_page := tabs.selected()
        navigation := focus.input(&input)
        current := focus.current()
        if current != applied_focus {
            tabs.set_focus(current == 1)
            button.set_focus(current == 2)
            check.set_focus(current == 3)
            toggle.set_focus(current == 4)
            slider.set_focus(current == 5)
            radio_a.set_focus(current == 6)
            radio_b.set_focus(current == 7)
            list.set_focus(current == 8)
            scroll.set_focus(current == 9)
            applied_focus = current
        }
        if navigation.consumed { -> }
        action := tabs.input(&input)
        if action.request_focus { focus.focus(1) or >> }
        if tabs.selected() != old_page {
            if tabs.selected() == 0 { focus.set_items([1,2,3,4,5,6,7]) or >> }
            else if tabs.selected() == 1 { focus.set_items([1,8,9]) or >> }
            else { focus.set_items([1]) or >> }
            focus.focus(1) or >>
            button.cancel()
            toggle.cancel()
            slider.cancel()
            radio_a.cancel()
            radio_b.cancel()
            list.cancel()
            scroll.set_focus(false)
        } else if tabs.selected() == 0 {
            a := button.input(&input)
            b := check.input(&input)
            c := toggle.input(&input)
            d := slider.input(&input)
            e := radio_a.input(&input)
            f := radio_b.input(&input)
            if a.kind == widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE { count += 1 }
            if e.kind == widgets.ACTION_CHANGE { selected = 0 }
            if f.kind == widgets.ACTION_CHANGE { selected = 1 }
            radio_a.set_value(selected == 0)
            radio_b.set_value(selected == 1)
            if a.request_focus { focus.focus(2) or >> }
            if b.request_focus { focus.focus(3) or >> }
            if c.request_focus { focus.focus(4) or >> }
            if d.request_focus { focus.focus(5) or >> }
            if e.request_focus { focus.focus(6) or >> }
            if f.request_focus { focus.focus(7) or >> }
        } else if tabs.selected() == 1 {
            a := list.input(&input) or >>
            _ := scroll.input(&input) or >>
            if a.request_focus { focus.focus(8) or >> }
            if input.kind == ui.EV_POINTER_DOWN && box(322.0,114.0,276.0,172.0).contains(input.x,input.y) { focus.focus(9) or >> }
        }
        current_after := focus.current()
        if current_after != applied_focus {
            tabs.set_focus(current_after == 1)
            button.set_focus(current_after == 2)
            check.set_focus(current_after == 3)
            toggle.set_focus(current_after == 4)
            slider.set_focus(current_after == 5)
            radio_a.set_focus(current_after == 6)
            radio_b.set_focus(current_after == 7)
            list.set_focus(current_after == 8)
            scroll.set_focus(current_after == 9)
            applied_focus = current_after
        }
    }
    progress.set_value(slider.value() / 100.0) or >>
    invalid_progress.set_value(slider.value() / 100.0) or >>
    disabled_progress.set_value(slider.value() / 100.0) or >>
    $frame := context.new_frame(8192)
    frame.begin() or >>
    frame.clear(styles.background) or >>
    draw.text(20,12,21,"#f5f0ed","Xu / WASM control gallery")
    tabs.paint($&frame,&tab_labels,&theme) or >>
    if tabs.selected() == 0 {
        button.paint_styled($&frame,$&button_label,&styles) or >>
        check.paint_styled($&frame,$&check_label,&styles) or >>
        toggle.paint_styled($&frame,$&switch_label,&styles) or >>
        slider.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
        radio_a.paint_styled($&frame,$&radio_a_label,&styles) or >>
        radio_b.paint_styled($&frame,$&radio_b_label,&styles) or >>
        draw.text(32,274,16,"#b3aab6","Count: " + str(count) + "   Slider: " + str(int(slider.value())))
    } else if tabs.selected() == 1 {
        draw.text(32,90,14,"#94a3b8","ListBox: click / Up / Down / End")
        draw.text(322,90,14,"#94a3b8","Scroll: wheel / Tab + PageDown")
        list.paint($&frame,&rows,&theme) or >>
        scroll.begin($&frame) or >>
        for i in 0:8 {
            label := rows[i]
            frame.text_layout(&label,12.0,12.0 + f64(i) * 42.0,theme.foreground) or >>
        }
        scroll.end($&frame) or >>
    } else {
        card.paint($&frame,&theme) or >>
        title.paint_text_styled($&frame,&box(42.0,116.0,410.0,36.0),&styles,&styles.button,0) or >>
        badge.paint($&frame,&badge_label,&theme) or >>
        draw.text(52,174,15,"#94a3b8","Progress: normal / invalid / disabled (Basics slider)")
        progress.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
        invalid_progress.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
        disabled_progress.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
        frame.push() or >>
        frame.translate(52.0,244.0) or >>
        editor.paint($&frame,&theme) or >>
        frame.pop() or >>
    }
    draw.text(20,328,13,"#94a3b8","Tab / Shift+Tab: focus   Arrows: change tab or value   Esc: leave")
    frame.present() or >>
    println("Page: " + str(tabs.selected()) + " | Count: " + str(count) + " | Check: " + str(check.value()) + " | Switch: " + str(toggle.value()) + " | Slider: " + str(int(slider.value())) + " | Radio: " + str(selected) + " | List: " + str(list.selected()) + " | Scroll: " + str(int(scroll.offset())))
    << 0
}
fn main() int {
    << demo() or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1 }
}

files.main.xu:
@main
#ui
#ui/draw
#ui/layout
#ui/widgets
#playground
#time

fn box(x f64,y f64,w f64,h f64) layout.Rect {
    << layout.Rect{x: x,y: y,width: w,height: h}
}
fn demo() int {
    identity := playground.canvas_identity()
    context := draw.default_context()
    theme := playground.dark_theme()
    styles := playground.dark_styles()
    options := ["Design","Develop","Review"]
    headers := ["Workspace","Members"]
    bounds := box(32.0,86.0,550.0,180.0)
    $control := widgets.chart(&context,&identity,1,&bounds) or >>
    $last := 0
    $series := widgets.chart_series(1,"Workspace",widgets.CHART_BAR)
    series.points = [widgets.chart_point(1,1.0,12.0),widgets.chart_point(2,2.0,8.0),widgets.chart_point(3,3.0,5.0)]
    control.set_series(&[series]) or >>
    _ := control.tick(&styles,time.instant_from_ns(1) or >>,true) or >>
    control.apply_styles(&styles) or >>
    $focus := widgets.focus_group(&identity,[1]) or >>
    while true {
        event := playground.next_input()
        if event.kind == 0 { <- }
        navigation := focus.input(&event)
        control.set_focus(focus.current() == 1)
        if navigation.consumed { -> }
        action := control.input(&event) or >>
        if action.request_focus { focus.focus(1) or >> }
        if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE { last = int(action.value) }
    }
    $frame := context.new_frame(8192)
    frame.begin() or >>
    frame.clear(styles.background) or >>
    frame.fill_rect(28.0,70.0,584.0,240.0,draw.rgb(25,22,28)) or >>
    frame.stroke_rect(28.0,70.0,584.0,240.0,draw.rgb(62,54,69),1.0) or >>
    draw.text(32,22,20,"#f5f0ed","XUUI  /  Chart")
    draw.text(32,48,12,"#b3aab6","将一组数据转为图形")
    control.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
    message := "Selected point: " + str(control.selection().point_id)
    draw.text(32,326,13,"#b3aab6",message + "")
    println(message)
    frame.present() or >>
    << 0
}
fn main() int {
    << demo() or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1 }
}

    identity := playground.canvas_identity()

        navigation := focus.input(&event)
        control.set_focus(focus.current() == 1)
        if navigation.consumed { -> }

        if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE { last = int(action.value) }
    }
    $frame := context.new_frame(8192)
    frame.begin() or >>
    frame.clear(styles.background) or >>
    frame.fill_rect(28.0,70.0,584.0,240.0,draw.rgb(25,22,28)) or >>

exercise.zh: 在控件上右键，或聚焦后按 Enter 打开菜单并选择命令
exercise.en: Right-click the control, or focus it and press Enter, to open the menu and choose a command

files.main.xu:
@main
#ui
#ui/draw
#ui/layout
#ui/widgets
#playground
#time

fn box(x f64,y f64,w f64,h f64) layout.Rect {
    << layout.Rect{x: x,y: y,width: w,height: h}
}
fn demo() int {
    identity := playground.canvas_identity()
    context := draw.default_context()
    theme := playground.dark_theme()
    styles := playground.dark_styles()
    options := ["Design","Develop","Review"]
    headers := ["Workspace","Members"]
    bounds := box(48.0,86.0,544.0,180.0)
    items := [widgets.menu_item(1,"Save"),widgets.menu_item(2,"Export"),widgets.menu_item(3,"Duplicate")]
    $control := widgets.menu(&context,&identity,1,&bounds,"Right-click here / 在此右键",&items,widgets.MENU_CONTEXT,0) or >>
    $last := 0
    control.set_viewport(&box(0.0,0.0,640.0,360.0)) or >>
    control.apply_styles(&styles) or >>
    $focus := widgets.focus_group(&identity,[1]) or >>
    while true {
        event := playground.next_input()
        if event.kind == 0 { <- }
        navigation := focus.input(&event)
        control.set_focus(focus.current() == 1)
        if navigation.consumed { -> }
        action := control.input(&event) or >>
        if action.request_focus { focus.focus(1) or >> }
        if action.kind == widgets.ACTION_ACTIVATE { last = int(action.value) }
        _ := control.tick(&styles,time.instant_from_ns(event.time_ns) or >>,true) or >>
    }
    $frame := context.new_frame(8192)
    frame.begin() or >>
    frame.clear(styles.background) or >>
    frame.fill_rect(28.0,70.0,584.0,240.0,draw.rgb(25,22,28)) or >>
    frame.stroke_rect(28.0,70.0,584.0,240.0,draw.rgb(62,54,69),1.0) or >>
    draw.text(32,22,20,"#f5f0ed","XUUI  /  ContextMenu")
    draw.text(32,48,12,"#b3aab6","在操作对象附近显示相关命令")
    control.paint_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
    control.paint_popup_styled($&frame,&styles) or >>
    message := "Command: " + str(last)
    draw.text(32,326,13,"#b3aab6",message + "")
    println(message)
    frame.present() or >>
    << 0
}
fn main() int {
    << demo() or (err) { eprintln(err.msg())
        << 1 }
}

description.zh: 组合默认操作与备选命令
description.en: Combine a primary action with alternatives

exercise.zh: 使用默认动作，再展开备选项
exercise.en: Use the main action and choose an alternative
